newsitem.title: USA: New Horizon Kids signs center agreement.
newsitem.headline: New Horizon Kids signs center agreement.

text.p: New Horizon Kids Quest Inc said Thursday it signed an agreement with Treasure Island Resort & Casino in Red Wing, Minn., to provide a combination hourly child care/supervised video entertainment center and a New Horizon Child Care center.

"This agreement is very exciting to Kids Quest, as this is the first agreement with a casino to provide all three of the company's products," Sue Dunkley, president of New Horizon Kids Quest, said in a statement. "The company will be able to serve the guests of the casino by providing child care at its Kids Quest location, with older children and adults enjoying the video entertainment center."
Sge added the New Horizon Child Care component will provide traditional child care to casino employees, as well as members of the community.
New Horizon Kids Quest also said it opened its 14th Kids Quest location at Sunset Station in Las Vegas. This location also represents the third location with Station Casinos Inc.
